## Equations
### EQ001 — Multinomial log-likelihood-ratio test

*Computes per-circuit context-dependence evidence and its Wilks p-value.*

$$
\lambda=2\sum_{c,m}x_{c,m}\log\!\left(\frac{x_{c,m}}{N_c\,x_m/N}\right),\quad k=(C-1)(M-1),\quad p=1-F_k(\lambda)
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `multinomial maximum-likelihood estimates under pooled and context-specific models` · source: paper_equations: Eqs. (3)-(6), Section II.A

Numerical form:

```
expected[c,m] = row_total[c] * column_total[m] / total; lambda = 2*sum(x*log(x/expected)) over positive x; p = scipy.stats.chi2.sf(lambda, k)
```

Code: `code/scripts/reproduce_context_dependence.py::log_likelihood_ratio`, `code/scripts/reproduce_context_dependence.py::analyze_contexts`


### EQ002 — Hochberg pseudo-threshold

*Controls the family-wise error rate across per-circuit tests.*

$$
p_{\mathrm{threshold}}=\frac{\beta}{Q-l_{\max}+1},\qquad \lambda_{\mathrm{threshold}}=F_k^{-1}(1-p_{\mathrm{threshold}})
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `Hochberg step-up multiple-testing procedure` · source: paper_equations: Eqs. (9)-(10), Section II.B

Numerical form:

```
sort p increasingly; retain the largest one-based rank l satisfying p[l] <= beta/(Q-l+1); use scipy.stats.chi2.isf for the LLR threshold
```

Code: `code/scripts/reproduce_context_dependence.py::hochberg_threshold`


### EQ003 — Aggregate LLR and signed standard deviation

*Detects context dependence distributed across many circuits.*

$$
\lambda_{\mathrm{agg}}=\sum_q\lambda_q,\quad k_{\mathrm{agg}}=Q(C-1)(M-1),\quad \mathcal{N}_\sigma=\frac{\lambda_{\mathrm{agg}}-k_{\mathrm{agg}}}{\sqrt{2k_{\mathrm{agg}}}}
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `additivity of independent log likelihood ratios and chi-square degrees of freedom` · source: paper_equations: Eqs. (11)-(14), Section II.B

Numerical form:

```
sum per-circuit lambda and degrees of freedom; standardize by exact chi-square mean and standard deviation
```

Code: `code/scripts/reproduce_context_dependence.py::analyze_contexts`


### EQ004 — Observed Jensen-Shannon divergence

*Quantifies context-dependent changes while separating the source notebook's plotting normalization.*

$$
\operatorname{JSD}_q=\frac{\lambda_q}{2N_q}=H\!\left(\sum_c\pi_cP_c\right)-\sum_c\pi_cH(P_c),\qquad \pi_c=N_c/N_q
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ001`, `weighted Shannon entropy expansion` · source: paper_equations: Eqs. (15)-(17), Section III.A; supplement_code: anc/Fig2.ipynb plotting cell

Numerical form:

```
compute entropy JSD directly and require equality to lambda/(2*sum_context_counts); retain lambda/(2*per_context_count) only as the released Fig. 2 compatibility ordinate
```

Code: `code/scripts/reproduce_context_dependence.py::entropy_jsd`, `code/scripts/reproduce_context_dependence.py::analyze_contexts`


### EQ005 — TVD, SSTVD, and maximum SSTVD

*Quantifies the largest statistically detected context dependence in Fig. 3.*

$$
\operatorname{TVD}(P_1,P_2)=\frac12\sum_m|P_1(m)-P_2(m)|,\quad \operatorname{SSTVD}_q=\begin{cases}\operatorname{TVD}_q,&\lambda_q>\lambda_{\mathrm{threshold}}\\\mathrm{null},&\mathrm{otherwise}\end{cases},\quad \max_q\operatorname{SSTVD}_q
$$

status: `verified` · derived from: `EQ002` · source: paper_equations: Eqs. (18)-(21), Section III.B

Numerical form:

```
for two binary contexts compute 0.5*sum(abs(p1-p2)); attach the value only to Hochberg-significant circuits and take the maximum over non-null entries
```
